concepts.name: Finding Common Ground
concepts.definition: Central learning focus of Finding Common Ground.
concepts.source_evidence: 3 FINDING COMMON GROUND 3.1 The Greatest of All Sameeksha is building her new house.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Use source information, observation or valid working to support a conclusion.
concepts.source_evidence: She feels that the room would look nice if the floor is covered with square tiles of the same size.

concepts.name: Application and transfer
concepts.definition: Use the learned idea in a relevant new context.
concepts.source_evidence: She also wants to use as few tiles as possible, and for the length of the tile to be a whole number of feet.
